instructions: Does this diff introduce a concrete behavioural regression relative to the before version? Use the before/after source and supplied context. Distinguish intentional behaviour changes from contradictions or broken contracts. Do not report speculative problems without supporting code.

criteria.no_evidence: No concrete regression is established by this context.
criteria.likely_regression: The change visibly breaks a contract or previously working behaviour.
criteria.insufficient_context: Required callers, contracts or implementation details are missing.
